sitting.request: Help me decide whether we should rewrite the sync feature. Give me one sitting to weigh the cost of keeping it.
sitting.why: A single decision, with room to weigh options and leave a question for the agent.

series.request: Help me prepare for a distributed systems interview over three spaced rounds. Start with what I can recall before I study.
series.why: Several returns to the same topic, starting with recall before notes.

incubation.request: Help me name a new project. Give me a generating session, a break, and a separate judging session.
incubation.why: Idea generation and evaluation have different places on the page.

ritual.request: Make a short weekly check-in page I can print again in the same form.
ritual.why: One repeatable page makes it easier to compare what changed.

proof.request: Print this draft about daily team meetings as a numbered proof with wide margins for my notes.
proof.why: Numbered paragraphs and open margins make a document ready for ink.

game-dev.request: Help me scope my game for a two-week jam: what it is, what the loop is, and what to cut.
game-dev.why: One scoping decision in one sitting, drawn from the Game Development collection: practical formats game designers already use, beside a research-backed pre-mortem.
